# Return contract — `survey`

<!-- Generated by generate_agent_definitions.py; do not edit. -->
<!-- delivery-version: c35418343fe8896348732bd54f8256de17338f8d 2026-11-07T14:33:16+01:00 -->

Return a JSON object with `status`, `inventory`, `signals`, `referrals`, `read_receipts`, and `missing_evidence`, plus `refusals`. `inventory` lists every unit of the assigned material with its path and range.
Each `signals` entry carries `lens`, `path`, `line_start`, `line_end`, and `observation`: the mechanism present, such as a construct, pattern, coupling, or absence.
State no failure mode, asserted or conditional; a hypothetical defect is still a defect claim.
The lens and line range carry the routing. `referrals` records anything observed that no registered lens covers.

Where the assignment names per-item `summary` fields, add that `summary` to each inventory entry with exactly those fields; a summary describes an item and never asserts a defect, a severity, or a cause.

This role holds the coverage guarantee for the run, so its receipts SHALL account for the whole assigned material and any unread range SHALL be named.
Do not adjudicate defects, assign severity, or propose fixes; a survey reports what is present and what is unresolved.

After a complete read with no lens-relevant signal, return `status: complete`, `signals: []`, and `empty_result: NO_FINDINGS`, retaining the inventory and receipts.
Missing evidence or unread ranges require `status: incomplete` and never the clean empty token; a failed, truncated, or refused return is not an empty result, and a refusal requires `status: refused` with `refusals` populated.
